desktop.notesZh:
批次十四（splash 首次启动提示 + 流程图图例删除 + 测试流配置文件列与模板落盘 + 测试流画布美化 + 运行错误解析）
① splash：首次启动（本机尚无 Node 运行时缓存）3 秒后右上角浮出「首次启动正在初始化运行环境，耗时可能较长，请耐心等待」，正常启动不显示。② 工作流·项目工程、确认门两个流程图删除图例。③ 测试流·环境表：删除「质量资产 已应用到工作区」行，「用途」后新增「配置文件」列——每个工具列出所需配置文件 chips（project.yml、.baf/quality/ceedling-config.json、CPPLINT.cfg、cppcheck-suppressions.xml、.clang-format），点击模态预览真实内容、右上角「打开」可直达文件；未写入的文件淡显并标注「未写入」；一键安装把 quality+c 双包全部配置模板写入工程。④ 测试流图 canvas 重绘：品牌色渐变竖向导轨 + 序号渐变气泡（带光晕环）、「主链/独立」阶段徽章、工具环境状态 chip、节点卡内嵌品牌色边条与 hover 浮起，信息更完整、观感更炫酷。⑤ 会话测试流图运行失败后新增「错误解析」卡：按真实退出码与输出识别九类原因（超时/工具缺失/配置文件缺失/路径不存在/权限或占用/静态检查发现/编译链接失败/单测失败/覆盖率不达标，兜底通用），逐类给出「原因」与「解决方法」。
desktop.notesEn:
Batch fourteen (splash first-launch hint + flow-chart legends removed + test-flow config-file column with template seeding + test-flow canvas restyle + run error analysis)
(1) Splash: on first launch (no cached Node runtime yet) a hint floats in the top-right after 3s — first launch is initializing the runtime and may take longer; normal launches never show it. (2) The Workflow > project and gate flow charts drop their legends. (3) Test-flow environment table: the applied-to-workspace row is gone; a Config-files column right after Purpose lists each tool's required config files as chips (project.yml, .baf/quality/ceedling-config.json, CPPLINT.cfg, cppcheck-suppressions.xml, .clang-format) — click to preview the real content in a modal with an Open button top-right; files not yet written dim with a not-written tag; one-click install now seeds every template from both the quality and c packs. (4) Test-flow canvas redraw: brand-gradient vertical rail, gradient index bubbles with glow rings, main-chain/side-chain phase badges, live tool-state chips, inset brand accent edge plus hover lift per node. (5) A failed run in the session test-flow tab now renders an error-analysis card: the real exit code and output classify nine causes (timeout / tool missing / config file missing / path missing / locked or permission / static findings / compile-link failure / unit-test failure / coverage below gate, plus an honest generic fallback), each with cause and fix guidance.
